incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT 3172 | High rate of tool/fncall errors + structured-output CPU spikes in prod-us-west-2. Paging #eng-oncall — metrics: toolcall error rate ↑, p95 latency ↑, node CPU ~90%.
rachel: I'm on it. Seeing a correlated increase in long JSON serializations and external agent timeouts. Likely cascading retries.
kevin: Dashboard: https://status.redwood.ai/metrics/3172 — toolcall errors ~5x, impacted pods concentrated in us-west-2-a/b. Suggest quick live mitigations: throttle tool invocations and force text-only fallback.
rachel: Proposed mitigation plan (T-0):
1) Soft-mute external tool invocations for free & trial plans
2) Globally disable structured_output serialization for 15m as a fallback
3) Increase external call timeout to avoid long blocking on proxy
I can flip flags now if y'all agree.
jules: Support will notify top-10 paying tenants and open priority tickets. I'll post updates to customers-team.
rachel: Executing toggles now:
```bash
# incident toggles
rwctl feature disable structured_output --scope global --reason "inc3172: cpu spike"
rwctl rate-limit set fncall_per_minute 20 --scope plan:free,trial --session incident3172
adminctl timeout set external_agent_call 3000ms --session incident3172
```
oncall-bot: Command acknowledged: structured_output disabled (global) by rachel @ 1745019952. Rate limit applied to plans: free, trial. external_agent_call timeout set to 3000ms.
kevin: Runtime team: can we add a short-lived proxy guard to reject external invocations that exceed 3s and return text-only placeholder? That should prevent kvcache stalls.
alex: Patch ready. Can rollout proxy guard to 25% of nodes in us-west-2 immediately.
rachel: Rolling to 25% now, monitoring p95 and CPU/IO.
oncall-bot: Rollout: proxy-guard 25% (us-west-2) started by alex @ 174501 ? status: in-progress
jules: Support: notified customers A,B,C,D. Posting in customer status page and opening follow-ups.
rachel: Quick metrics after toggles: p95 latency down from ~3.1s to ~1.3s, toolcall error rate down ~70%. Node CPU trending down.
kevin: Good drop. Recommendation: keep structured_output disabled for 30m, keep new rate limit on free/trial until 08:00 UTC tomorrow, then evaluate. Prepare rollback steps in case re-enable causes instability.
rachel: Agreed. I'll hand off to night oncall in 30m. @kevin please author a short rollback playbook (steps + sanity metrics). Also start a postmortem draft in incident-tracker.
kevin: On it — will include exact rwctl commands to re-enable and metrics thresholds (p95 < 1.5s, error rate < 10% of baseline).
oncall-bot: Handoff scheduled to @maria (night oncall) at 1745020400.
maria: Taking over for night. Please ping me directly if anything spikes or if customers report regressions.
rachel: Thanks team — will attach logs, screenshots, and the exact session IDs for the toggles to the incident doc.
kevin: I'll also preserve sampled requests for later evals.
incident-bot: INCIDENT 3172 | mitigations applied. Monitoring mode active. Postmortem: start draft in 24h.
